lemmas.primary_translation: to get away from something by a narrow margin and without injury

definitions.text: komme ifra noe med knapp margin og uten men
definitions.translation: get away from something by a narrow margin and without injury (lit. to get off with the fright)

examples.no: han slapp unna kollisjonen med skrekken
examples.en: he got away from the collision with only a scare
